title: River Run
summary: Free group runs along the Thames, three times a week, from Bermondsey.

organiser.name: London City Runners
organiser.about: A free running club based at the Marquis of Wellington pub in Bermondsey. Social membership is free.

sessions.label: Tuesday, 6:15pm
sessions.note: All paces. Easy group (about 6:30 per km) leaves at 6:45pm.

sessions.label: Sunday, 10:30am
sessions.note: Routes head east. No bag drop on Sundays.

description: Weekday runs head west along the river to Millennium Bridge (about 6.5k), Blackfriars Bridge (8k) or Westminster Bridge (11k) and back. Sunday runs head east: about 6.5k, 10k to Greenland Pier, or 18k through the Greenwich foot tunnel and back over Tower Bridge. Social membership is free: make a profile on the club's website, then turn up.

title: Wednesday Run & Social
summary: A 7.5k riverside loop over Tower Bridge, then a drink.

organiser.name: London Social Runners
organiser.about: A free social running group with two regular weekly runs, each followed by a drink or brunch together.

venue: National Theatre, river side main entrance
description: A 7.5km loop along the river, over Tower Bridge and back across Waterloo Bridge, then a drink together. Aimed at runners comfortable at around 6 minutes per km or quicker. RSVP on Meetup.

title: Saturday Run & Brunch
summary: One easy lap of Hyde Park, then brunch.

organiser.name: London Social Runners
organiser.about: A free social running group with two regular weekly runs, each followed by a drink or brunch together.

venue: Kensington Gardens, just inside Kings Arms Gate
address: Near the Royal Garden Hotel, 2-24 Kensington High Street, London W8
description: One easy 6.5km lap of Hyde Park, about 30 to 50 minutes, then brunch. The group leaves on time. RSVP on Meetup.

title: Cheapside Run Club
summary: A 5k through the City for all abilities, every Wednesday after work.

organiser.name: Cheapside Business Alliance
organiser.about: Runs the club with Pure Sports Medicine St Paul's. No booking needed; updates go out on the club's WhatsApp community.

venue: Pure Sports Medicine St Paul's, 1st floor
description: A 5k for all abilities through the City, starting and finishing at One New Change. No booking needed; join the WhatsApp community for updates.

title: Our Parks at Victory Park
summary: Free coached outdoor classes five days a week in East Village.

organiser.name: Our Parks
organiser.about: Free, coach-led outdoor exercise classes in parks across London. The Victory Park classes are funded by Get Living London.

description: Coached classes for all ages and abilities, suitable for beginners. Bring a bottle of water. Free, but register with Our Parks and book each class to reserve your space.
